endpoint.name: ai-search.perplexity.answer — routed: best of 2 providers, own keys first
endpoint.summary: Ask Perplexity a question — the answer text and its cited sources; `source_kind` says whether it came from the Perplexity website or its model API

cost.note: NOT free: misses are billed too. the children's range $0.0024–$0.005861 per hit, 0% markup; you pay the child that served AND every child tried before it that bills a miss (2 of 2 do), up to X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost (default $1 a call). X-Treg-Route-Exclude them, or X-Treg-Route-Waterfall: 0, to pay for one provider only

country.note: filter — default 'US'; ISO 3166-1 alpha-2: where the question is asked from

input.note: Send everything you know about the subject — treg derives the rest (full_name ⇄ first+last), matches each provider on the variants it accepts ({prompt}) and sends each provider only the fields it wants. On a miss treg keeps trying providers, cheapest first, within X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost (default $1 per call; misses on per-success providers are free). Options ride as headers, never in the body: X-Treg-Route-Waterfall: 0 (stop at the first miss), X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost: <usd>, X-Treg-Route-Prefer / X-Treg-Route-Exclude: <provider>. The response is {output, raw, _treg: {served_by, tried}}; X-Treg-Served-By names the child.

sources.note: the provider's own cited-source objects; raw is the same body

source_kind.note: website = the public Perplexity site, as a user there sees it; model_api = Perplexity's model API (sonar). The two cite largely different sources for the same question

headers.X-Treg-Route-Waterfall: on by default: a miss tries the next provider; 0 = stop at the first miss
headers.X-Treg-Route-Max-Cost: USD ceiling for the whole call (default 1.00)
headers.X-Treg-Route-Strict-Filters: 1 = never call a provider that cannot apply a filter you sent (answers 422, nothing charged); off by default — the answer names what was ignored in X-Treg-Ignored-Filters

siblings.name: Perplexity answer — text, sources, media, shopping
siblings.summary: Runs a prompt through the live Perplexity interface from a chosen country and returns the answer text with its cited sources, citation pills, shopping cards, media results and travel/place cards.
siblings.call_template: treg call cloro.ai-search.perplexity.answer --method POST --data '{"prompt":"what is a stock split","country":"US","include":{"markdown":true,"html":true,"rawResponse":true}}'

cost.note: 4 base + the 2-credit sync surcharge. Every include flag on this endpoint is free — only `state` moves the price, by 2. A failed extraction is not charged.

state.note: US state code for state-level targeting; adds 2 credits

include.note: any of markdown, html, rawResponse. All three are free on this endpoint.

samples.reason: Perplexity returned 400 MODEL_UNAVAILABLE (logged-out sessions broken); not charged.
Concise definition for the direct question and cites Travel by B Corp's own site plus relevant independent sources.
Consumer Perplexity answer with sources and related queries; source set matched the API run closely, useful as a cross-check. Many sibling calls timed out at the MCP layer.

siblings.name: Perplexity answer to a prompt, live
siblings.summary: Live Perplexity LLM Responses endpoint allows you to retrieve structured responses from a specific Perplexity AI model, based on the input parameters.
siblings.call_template: treg call dataforseo.x.ai-optimization-perplexity-llm-responses-live --method POST --data '[{"system_message":"communicate as if we are in a business meeting","message_chain":[{"role":"user","message":"Hello, what’s up?"},{"role":"ai","message":"Hello! I’m doing well, thank you. How can I assist you today? Are there any specific topics or projects you’d like to discuss in our meeting?"}],"max_output_tokens":200,"temperature":0.3,"top_p":0.5,"web_search_country_iso_code":"FR","model_name":"sonar","user_prompt":"provide information on how relevant the amusement park business is in France now"}]'

cost.note: price observed at live verification (provider-reported charge)

user_prompt.note:
prompt for the AI model
required field
the question or task you want to send to the AI model;
you can specify up to 500 characters in the user_prompt field
user_prompt.example: provide information on how relevant the amusement park business is in France now

model_name.note:
name of the AI model
required field
model_nameconsists of the actual model name and version name;
if the basic model name is specified, its latest version will be set by default;
you can receive the list of available LLM models by making a separate

max_output_tokens.note:
maximum number of tokens in the AI response
optional field
minimum value: 1
maximum value: 4096;
default value: 2048;
Note: if the reasoning model is specified in the request, the output token count may exceed the specif

temperature.note:
randomness of the AI response
optional field
higher values make output more diverse
lower values make output more focused
minimum value: 0
maximum value: 1.9
default value: 0.77

top_p.note:
diversity of the AI response
optional field
controls diversity of the response by limiting token selection
minimum value: 0
maximum value: 1
default value: 0.9

web_search_country_iso_code.note:
country code for web search localization
optional field
specify the country ISO code to get localized web search results
Note: available only for Perplexity Sonar models
example: US

system_message.note:
instructions for the AI behavior
optional field
defines the AI's role, tone, or specific behavior
you can specify up to 500 characters in the system_message field
system_message.example: communicate as if we are in a business meeting

message_chain.note: conversation history optional field array of message objects representing previous conversation turns; each object must contain: role string with either user or ai role; message string with message content (max 500 characters); you can specify maximum of 10 message objects in the array; Note: for Pe

example.message: Hello! I’m doing well, thank you. How can I assist you today? Are there any specific topics or projects you’d like to discuss in our meeting?

tag.note:
user-defined task identifier
optional field
the character limit is 255
you can use this parameter to identify the task and match it with the result
you will find the specified tag value in the data object of the response

input.note: POST body is a JSON array that must contain exactly one task object (Live endpoints do not support multi-task arrays). Extra elements return per-task status 40000 "You can set only one task at a time" ($0 on the rejected tasks) while HTTP stays 200 — one prompt per call.

body.system_message: communicate as if we are in a business meeting

message_chain.message: Hello! I’m doing well, thank you. How can I assist you today? Are there any specific topics or projects you’d like to discuss in our meeting?

body.user_prompt: provide information on how relevant the amusement park business is in France now

samples.reason: National answer named implementers with citations.
Sonar with US or DE web-search country answered 15 of 15 prompts in a few seconds at about USD 0.006 each, with 6-10 annotation URLs per answer; good for brand-mention checks.
Sonar with AU country code, 40/40 answered with 10 annotation URLs each in ~3s; best value per cited domain. Occasionally cites wrong-country pages for ambiguous suburb names.
